proceedings.deciding_body: 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: The 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court dismissed the case on 9 December 2014.

proceedings.deciding_body: General Assembly of the Administrative Proceedings Divisions of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 7 July 2015, the General Assembly of the Administrative Proceedings Divisions of the Supreme Administrative Court annulled the Fund's decision, ruling that the valuation was based on an outdated 2009 report and did not reflect current market value.

proceedings.outcome: rejected it, making the annulment final
proceedings.supporting_quote: The Fund requested rectification on 25 January 2016, but the Supreme Administrative Court rejected it, making the annulment final.

proceedings.deciding_body: 6th Chamber of the İstanbul Administrative Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 19 March 2014, the 6th Chamber of the İstanbul Administrative Court dismissed the claim, finding no irregularities in the sale.

proceedings.deciding_body: 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 9 December 2014, the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court upheld the dismissal (though two judges dissented).

proceedings.deciding_body: 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.outcome: overturned the lower court's decision and annulled the sale
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 30 June 2017, the 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court granted the applicant's request for rectification. Citing the previous annulment of the valuation (from the first set of proceedings), the court ruled that all actions based on that invalid valuation were legally invalid. The court overturned the lower court's decision and annulled the sale.

The Fund refused both requests, claiming that enforcement was legally and practically impossible because the assets had already been transferred to a "bona fide" third party and the proceeds had been spent.
On 23 May 2018, the Constitutional Court declared the application inadmissible because it was submitted after the 30-day legal time limit had expired.
